upper_base.notes: Midpoint of traced main envelope base fixes X and Z. HB35 separately controls shell dimensions; no refit of calibration.

upper_driver_base.notes: Standard assembled configuration only; closed plates/leaves. Local coordinates reference the enclosure base center or rear edge.

upper_lookout_base.notes: Standard assembled configuration only; closed plates/leaves. Local coordinates reference the enclosure base center or rear edge.

hull_shell.notes: Hull longitudinal/ground datum; transverse planes derive from track centers and lower shell clearance. Standard configuration.
